reasons.correctness: createTicket now publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent through ApplicationEventPublisher and no longer calls EmailService. The listener has @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) and sends with the event's five values. The interface names match exactly. Build green, 3/3 acceptance tests pass.

reasons.test_quality: The new MockitoExtension SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest covers the send with exact arguments and the swallowed exception. The CreateTicket unit test captures the event, asserts all six fields, and checks EmailService is untouched. The integration assertion was changed rather than deleted.
